queries.ValidatePostQuery:

  validatePost(
    CarExtraInfo: $carExtraInfo
    token: $token
    title: $title
    bodyTEXT: $bodyTEXT
    contact: $contact
    tags: $tags
    imagesList: $imagesList
    lat: $lat
    lon: $lon
    price: $price
    locationInfoSource: $locationInfoSource
    re_ExtraInfo: $re_ExtraInfo
    GeneralExtraInfo: $GeneralExtraInfo
  ) {
    status
    notValidReason
  }
}
